prompt:
Revise this EXACT8-frame B1 right-walk sprite action sheet as WHOLE CONTINUOUS CHARACTERS. Keep exact2rows x4columns equal square cells, original right profile, same mature face hair coat shirt trousers boots, right-hand lantern near camera, left-hip bag far side. Same frame ordering and walking poses as source. Reference1 is8complete bodies, not upper/lower cutouts; reference2 approved right standing sprite is costume/face/scale authority. Pixel art intended96x96 native percell enlarged4x; all heads/proportions and gear consistent. DO NOT make8new character designs.
PRIMARY FIX: coat must be UNINTERRUPTED CLOTH from shoulders through waist to calf hem, no horizontal waist cuts, no translucent cracks, no separated upper/lower pieces. In eachframe coat at native x36..40,y50..55 must be solid cloth, continuous pixels, not magenta seams. Let collar shoulder and back silhouette change only1native pixel with weight, not rigid whole-upper-body translation. Empty far arm may swing subtly partly hidden. Keep face steady and recognisable.
LANTERN MUST PENDULUM FROM THE GRIPPING HAND: hand and TOP HANDLE stay attached, bottom swings more than top, only1-2native-pixel tilt, NOT entire lamp sliding sideways. Keep lamp size7x17native, brass cap and base, opaque gray glass and clearly open handle. Root grip at right hand, no visible gap between fingers and handle. Right hand moves fore/aft only1-2native px, lamp angle lags oneframe. For frames1..8 use bottom-relative-to-top x offsets [-1,-2,-1,0,+1,+2,+1,0] nativepx; top mostly fixed at grip. Lamp is almost vertical at this smallscale, don't tilt more than~8degrees. Important eachframe lower lamp is1-2px offset from handle, not whole lamp shifted as a block. Keep1-2native px background AIR between lamp and coat everyframe, no overlap. No glow or trail.
WALK:8distinct poses,100ms each, grounded foot at nativey95, fixed body hipnative x48, no motion across canvas. Right near foot supports frames1-4, left far foot supports frames5-8. Frame1/5 forward heel contact,2/6 weight down,3/7 passing leg,4/8 high phase with opposite boot raised. Body crown heights native[1,2,1,0,1,2,1,0] only2px bob. Boots natural10-12px length. Front and back half loops physically alternate legs. Do not expand stride or randomly rearrange poses. Supporting boot contact pixel retreats left7nativepx perframe; final alignment will be checked. Coat tails lag legs slightly, bag bobs1px. Book only dark front-waist edge, NO CYAN. Entire complete sprite in central75% each cell, same scale and camera, ample magenta margins. SOLID #FF00FF background everywhere, no shadow, no ground, no guide lines, no text. Crisp square pixels, no antialiasing, no gradients, no smear. Do not reproduce seams from rejected composite.
whole_body_registration: continuous nearest-sampled coordinate map,torso rooted and foot baseline fixed;no rows cut out or joined
lamp_registration: hand contact preserved;only existing isolated lamp pixels below grip receive row-dependent1-2px inclination,not block translation
